categories.name: Composite Strapping
categories.seoTitle: Composite Strapping for Industrial Loads | FOCUSOURCE
categories.seoDescription: Explore polyester composite cord strapping for pallets, steel and machinery. Compare strap widths, breaking strength and packing options.
categories.intro: FOCUSOURCE composite cord strapping combines high-tenacity polyester yarns with a protective coating to secure demanding loads. Select width and strength according to cargo weight, handling and transport conditions.
benefits: High retained tension with shock absorption
Lightweight, flexible and easy to handle
Multiple widths and breaking-strength options

faqs.question: How do I select a composite strap width?
faqs.answer: Match the strap's system strength to the load, transport movement and lashing configuration. Share cargo details with us for a recommendation.

faqs.question: Can composite cord strapping be used outdoors?
faqs.answer: It is suitable for many export and industrial applications. Confirm exposure duration, weather conditions and required protection when requesting a quotation.

faqs.question: Which buckle should I use with the strap?
faqs.answer: Choose a buckle compatible with the strap width and lashing method. Wire buckles are commonly paired with composite cord strapping.

categories.name: Hotmelt Strapping
categories.seoDescription: Explore white hotmelt polyester strapping in 9, 13, 16 and 19 mm widths for bundling and pallet packaging. Contact FOCUSOURCE for other sizes and specifications.
categories.intro: Hotmelt strapping uses parallel polyester yarns bonded with hot-melt adhesive to form a flexible strap for bundling and pallet packaging. Available widths include 9 mm, 13 mm, 16 mm and 19 mm; contact us about other widths and application requirements.
benefits: Flexible bonded polyester yarn construction
9 mm, 13 mm, 16 mm and 19 mm widths available
Other sizes and packing details available on request

faqs.question: Which widths are available?
faqs.answer: Available widths include 9 mm, 13 mm, 16 mm and 19 mm. Contact us for other widths.

faqs.question: How does hotmelt strapping differ from composite strapping?
faqs.answer: Hotmelt strapping bonds parallel polyester yarns with hot-melt adhesive. Composite strapping encloses polyester yarns in a protective polymer coating. Choose the construction for your cargo and handling conditions.

faqs.question: How do I request a quotation?
faqs.answer: Provide the strap width, required breaking strength, roll length, order quantity and intended application. Confirm buckle and tool compatibility for your selected strap.

categories.name: Woven Lashing
categories.seoTitle: Woven Polyester Lashing for Heavy Cargo | FOCUSOURCE
categories.seoDescription: Find woven polyester lashing for machinery, steel and export cargo. Review 32-50 mm product specifications and packing options.
categories.intro: Woven polyester lashing is a flexible restraint material for heavy and irregular cargo. Its woven construction helps distribute load contact while retaining the handling advantages of textile lashing.
applications: Steel products, lumber and building materials
benefits: Flexible textile construction for varied load shapes
Multiple widths and system-strength choices
Roll or bag packing options by specification

faqs.question: What widths are available?
faqs.answer: The current range includes 32 mm, 40 mm and 50 mm options. Refer to each product specification for breaking strength and packing.

faqs.question: Can woven lashing be reused?
faqs.answer: Reuse depends on the lashing method, condition and applicable cargo-securing rules. Inspect for cuts, abrasion, contamination or damaged stitching before every use.

faqs.question: What information is needed for a quote?
faqs.answer: Provide cargo weight and dimensions, lashing arrangement, required length, destination and target delivery date.

categories.name: Wire Buckles
categories.seoTitle: Wire Buckles for Composite Strapping | FOCUSOURCE
categories.seoDescription: Compare wire buckle sizes, wire diameters and box packing for composite strapping. Request factory-direct supply from FOCUSOURCE.
categories.intro: Wire buckles form a friction joint with compatible composite cord strapping. Select the buckle by strap width, required joint performance and application method.
benefits: Self-locking friction-joint design
Multiple wire diameters and package quantities
Surface treatments available by specification

faqs.question: How do I match a wire buckle to my strap?
faqs.answer: Match the buckle size to strap width and follow the recommended threading and tensioning procedure for the selected system.

faqs.question: What surface treatments are available?
faqs.answer: Electroplated and phosphated finishes are listed for this range. Confirm the required finish and corrosion conditions when ordering.

faqs.question: How are wire buckles packed?
faqs.answer: Packing quantity and carton dimensions vary by model. Check the technical specification table for model-level details.

categories.name: Lashing Buckles
categories.seoTitle: Steel Lashing Buckles for Woven Lashing | FOCUSOURCE
categories.seoDescription: Source 30-50 mm steel lashing buckles for woven polyester lashing. Compare model, packing and finish specifications.
categories.intro: Lashing buckles connect compatible woven polyester lashing systems for cargo restraint. Choose a model based on lashing width, joint design and the securing method used on the load.
benefits: Models for 30 mm, 40 mm and 50 mm lashing
Steel buckle construction
Compact box packing for supply and storage

faqs.question: Which buckle width should I order?
faqs.answer: Select the buckle width to match the woven lashing width. Confirm compatibility with your tensioning method before ordering.

faqs.question: Are buckle color options available?
faqs.answer: The current specification lists silver and yellow. Confirm available finish and quantity with the sales team.

faqs.question: Can these buckles secure machinery?
faqs.answer: They are intended for compatible woven lashing systems. The full restraint design should account for cargo weight, movement and lashing points.

categories.name: Tools
categories.seoTitle: Strapping Tools, Tensioners & Heat Sealers | FOCUSOURCE
categories.seoDescription: Explore manual strapping tools, a heavy duty ratchet tensioner for 50 mm straps and the FKR400 heat sealer with a 400 mm sealing length. Request model details.
categories.intro: Explore tensioners and cutters for strapping, plus heat sealers for compatible packaging materials. The range includes a heavy duty ratchet tensioner for 50 mm straps and the FKR400 heat sealer with a 400 mm sealing length. Select each tool for the material and packaging task.
benefits: Portable equipment for on-site use
Tensioning, cutting or heat sealing according to model
Model-specific strap widths and sealing lengths

faqs.question: Which strap widths do the tools support?
faqs.answer: The strapping tool range covers 13 mm to 50 mm, including a heavy duty ratchet tensioner for 50 mm straps. The FKR400 heat sealer has a separate 400 mm sealing length; this is not a strap width. Confirm the selected model before purchase.

faqs.question: Do I need separate tensioning and cutting tools?
faqs.answer: Tool configuration depends on the strap and joint method. Share your current process and strap type for a compatible recommendation.

faqs.question: Are the tools suitable for field work?
faqs.answer: Manual tools are portable and can be used where compatible strapping is applied. Follow operating and safety instructions.

faqs.question: What does the FKR400 heat sealer support?
faqs.answer: The FKR400 provides a 400 mm sealing length for compatible heat-sealable packaging. Confirm your material type, thickness and power supply requirements before ordering.

categories.name: Dispenser
categories.seoDescription: Mobile dispenser trolley for composite strapping and woven lashing rolls, with 200 mm and 400 mm core options and tool storage tray.
categories.intro: A mobile strapping dispenser keeps coils organized at the packing station and makes material easier to move and dispense. Confirm roll dimensions and core compatibility before ordering.
applications: Storage of strap rolls, buckles and hand tools
benefits: Mobile trolley format
Core options listed for 200 mm and 400 mm
Tray for buckles and hand tools

faqs.question: Which coil cores are supported?
faqs.answer: The product information lists 200 mm and 400 mm core sizes. Confirm the roll's inner diameter and dimensions before ordering.

faqs.question: Can the trolley hold buckles and tools?
faqs.answer: The design includes a tray intended for buckles and hand tools. Confirm load capacity and dimensions for your setup.

faqs.question: Is the dispenser supplied with strapping?
faqs.answer: The dispenser is listed as equipment. Contact us to confirm whether strapping or accessories are included in a specific quotation.

categories.seoTitle: Vacuum Metallized Polyester Film VMPET | FOCUSOURCE
categories.seoDescription: Explore reflective VMPET laminated woven polyester film V-4110. Review its 120-micron construction, roll dimensions and technical data.
categories.intro: The V-4110 vacuum metallized polyester film is a reflective laminated roll material combining VMPET, PE and woven polyester layers. Review the listed technical properties and confirm application requirements with the supplier.
applications: Projects requiring a reflective laminated surface
benefits: VMPET + PE + PE woven + PE layer structure
120 micron thickness and 2 m x 100 m rolls
Technical data available for project review

faqs.question: What is the V-4110 film structure?
faqs.answer: The supplied specification lists VMPET + PE + PE WOVEN + PE. Confirm layer construction for the final purchase specification.

faqs.question: What are the roll dimensions?
faqs.answer: The listed size is 2 m x 100 m per roll, with a net weight of 22 kg per roll.

faqs.question: Can I use the listed permeability figures for design?
faqs.answer: The source specification's permeability units need supplier confirmation before engineering use. Request the test method and complete unit definition.

categories.name: Applications
categories.seoDescription: Explore polyester strapping and lashing approaches for pallets, containers, steel and building materials in export logistics.
categories.intro: Choose a load-securing approach around cargo geometry, weight, handling and transport conditions. FOCUSOURCE products support pallet, container, steel and building-material applications.
applications: Palletized cartons, drums and irregular loads
benefits: Match strap, buckle and tools to cargo requirements
Flexible textile strapping for varied load shapes
Application-focused product recommendations

faqs.question: What cargo information should I provide?
faqs.answer: Share cargo weight and dimensions, package type, transport mode, lashing points and any required restraint standard.

faqs.question: Can one strapping system cover every load?
faqs.answer: No. System selection depends on the cargo, transport movement, contact surfaces and securing method. Evaluate each application.

faqs.question: Can you recommend a lashing configuration?
faqs.answer: We can review your cargo details and recommend compatible products. Final securing design should follow applicable regulations and site procedures.
